## Failure paths and arms (fill in)

**What the chain above shows for issue #362.** The run starts from three nodes created by `topology up --fresh` immediately before it (never applied). In L4 the plays run in the new site.yml order: FreeIPA server, then `FreeIPA server replica join`, then the dns tier play (no host), FreeIPA client, then `FreeIPA DNS client`, then the rest. On `i362-ipa2` the replica play's self-register task added its A record on the primary (`changed`, delegated to `i362-ipa1`) and `ipa-replica-install` ran (`changed`). On `i362-c1` the providers task `WARNING: replicas left out` was skipped (the replica was already promoted when the client and dns-client plays asked FreeIPA for its DNS servers), the dns-client nameserver gate passed, and `ignored=0` on every host (no ignored pool probe failure, the symptom the Issue describes). host-monitoring, a later play on the same client, ran on the first apply after the resolver switch: it downloaded node_exporter from its upstream release URL and installed `apache2-utils` with apt, both `changed`, `failed=0`. External names therefore resolved through FreeIPA DNS; the primary's global forwarder came from the playbook default (`8.8.8.8`), no forwarder input was given to this run. L6 is `changed=0` on all three hosts, including both new plays.

**G-resolve on the real EL9 primary** (read-only, after the chain, on the same three VMs before they were torn down; clean `git archive` of `a2c2208e8896`; inventory rendered by `pilot vm-target topology inventory` for this topology; the same minimal vars file as the chain):

| Arm | Command (both `--check --tags always -e stage=sandbox -e freeipa_setup_dns=false`) | Observed |
|---|---|---|
| pass | `ansible-playbook -i <rendered inventory> playbooks/apply/freeipa-server-replica-apply.yml ...` | `getent ahostsv4 ipa2.ipa.pilot.internal` delegated to `i362-ipa1` ok; gate "All assertions passed"; `i362-ipa2 ok=22 changed=0 failed=0`; rc 0 |
| fire | same plus `-e freeipa_replica_fqdn=nope-i362.ipa.pilot.internal` | getent returned rc=2 with no address; the gate failed with "The primary i362-ipa1 runs no native FreeIPA DNS ... returned rc=2 [], not 192.168.122.24 ... Do the MANUAL PRE-STEP first ... Nothing was changed on this host."; `i362-ipa2 ok=11 changed=0 failed=1`; rc 2 |

`-e freeipa_setup_dns=false` makes the playbook treat the primary as having no native DNS, so the gate runs; the primary does run DNS here, which is why the real FQDN resolves (through its own named, after the self-registration in L4) and the made-up one does not. Both arms are check mode with a read-only delegated `getent`; nothing on either host changed.

**Earlier candidate** `09519b06b661` (before review round 2: no `serial: 1`, the gates still labelled R1-R3, older gate message text and comments) ran the same chain with `--ephemeral`: L1 pass, L3/L4 `failed=0` on all hosts, verify PASS 16/0/0 and 8/0/0, L6 `changed=0`, the same per-host PLAY RECAP counts as above. It is superseded by this record and is not evidence for `a2c2208e8896`.

**Local real-Ansible harness** (not a VM; `make site-day2-roles-test`, PASS on `a2c2208e8896`): the replica play's real pre_tasks and `serial` on localhost hosts with a captured-shape `getent` double: G-ip derivation, G-pool firing cases, G-resolve firing and passing cases, and two replica hosts under `serial: 1` (the first failing stops the second and the later play; the control without `serial` shows the second running).

## Not covered / limits (fill in)

- No two-replica topology: a topology file carries no per-host vars, and G-pool requires each of two or more replicas to set its own `freeipa_replica_fqdn`. Sequential promotion under `serial: 1` is shown only by the local harness above; #110 (concurrent self-register) is referenced, not claimed fixed.
- G-resolve fired on a primary that runs DNS, made to look DNS-less with `-e freeipa_setup_dns=false`. A full external-DNS deployment (primary installed without DNS, manual pre-step done, then promotion) was not run.
- No dns tier host: dns-apply's own G5 gate and stub forwarding were not executed; the "replica before dns" ordering was exercised only through the shared providers task that freeipa-dns-client includes.
- No EL consumer of freeipa-dns-client and no docker image pull after the resolver switch.
- No `pilot deploy` run: deploy.go is unchanged; host-role selection, `--limit` and tag scoping are covered by Go tests on a fake inventory plus a real `ansible-playbook --list-tasks` over site.yml (`cmd/pilot/cmd/site_yml_day2_roles_test.go`). No `--tags freeipa` / `--tags freeipa-dns-client` partial run on VM.
- No staging/prod stage path with confirm flags on the two plays.
- Only the replica and dns-client specs were verified (acceptance criterion 2); the freeipa-server and freeipa-client specs were not run in this chain.
- agent-controller is not part of this change (#195).
